name: SUM Parts
description: Semantic segmentation in urban scene analysis has mainly focused on images or point clouds, while textured meshes - offering richer spatial representation - remain underexplored. This paper introduces SUM Parts, the first large-scale dataset for urban textured meshes with part-level semantic labels, covering about 2.5 km2 with 21 classes. The dataset was created using our own annotation tool, which supports both face- and texture-based annotations with efficient interactive selection. We also provide a comprehensive evaluation of 3D semantic segmentation and interactive annotation methods on this dataset. Our project page is available at https://tudelft3d.github.io/SUMParts/.
reputation: The first large-scale dataset of urban textured meshes with part-level labels; gaining attention in the 3D vision and urban-scene communities for textured-mesh research.
notes: Large-scale and domain-specific (urban scenes, ~2.5 km2, 21 classes). Potential class imbalance across parts, annotation noise possible despite a dedicated tool, and not applicable to LLMs; best suited for 3D vision and graphics models.
